item.description: ### Fixed - **No more "trust these hooks" warning for a Codex you don't have.** Perch decided Codex was installed by looking for its `~/.codex` folder — but removing Codex doesn't necessarily remove that folder, so anyone who had tried Codex and moved on could be told forever to re-approve hooks for an agent that wasn't there. It now also checks that a `codex` you can actually run exists. If you do have Codex, nothing changes; the warning still appears whenever it genuinely needs your attention. - **Re-check now looks for Codex again from scratch.** If you install Codex while Perch is already running, pressing Re-check picks it up instead of you having to restart Perch.
